entry_state: Basic EPS uses the dated split-adjusted share denominator and attributed ordinary earnings. Options and convertible debt pass the sequential continuing-earnings dilution test, while preference shares fail after those admissions. The same admitted population determines total and discontinued EPS. The finite ordered selector has been introduced, with its assumptions and derivation continuing on page 184.
exit_state: The ordered EPS selector has a local proof for fixed additive positive-share increments and reports unsupported or unresolved instruments explicitly. Actual conversion splits actual and potential share windows; early exercise follows a selected practice interpretation with its source boundary retained. The whole-company conversion example has now introduced the running group's operating profit, cash/equity and opening parent shares; its instrument schedule continues next.
findings: The dilution inequality multiplies only positive denominators and does not divide by earnings, so signed and zero earnings are handled without an invalid sign shortcut.
The selected-set identity proves the minimum only under fixed additive effects; participation and mutually exclusive choices remain outside that claim.
The report distinguishes incomplete inventory, missing attribution, known dependent effects and invalid requests; a partial selection is not returned as complete.
The early-conversion case separates IAS 32's explicit maturity wording from a selected practice interpretation and separately supplies its tax facts. No new confirmed defect.

equation.exposition_role: Mechanism-bearing local algebraic derivation of strict dilution.
equation.symbols_units_domain: N and a are currency earnings, D and b weighted shares, with D>0 and b>0; ratios are currency per share.
equation.assumptions_timing: The candidate's increment is fixed and additive on the same reporting basis.
equation.source_and_equality: (N+a)/(D+b)<N/D iff D(N+a)<N(D+b) iff aD<Nb iff a/b<N/D; only positive quantities are divided or multiplied.
equation.interpretation: Equality is neutral; a loss can be diluted by making loss per share more negative.
equation.transition: The signed example and exact-ratio ordering apply the derived predicate.

equation.exposition_role: Proof identity for the finite fixed-additive subset selection.
equation.symbols_units_domain: N0 and a_i are currency earnings; D0 and b_i weighted shares; q is final currency-per-share ratio.
equation.assumptions_timing: D0>0, all candidate b_i>0, fixed independent effects and ascending exact-ratio strict admissions.
equation.source_and_equality: N0-qD0+sum_selected(a_i-qb_i)=0 is the definition of q rearranged; replacing negative selected terms or adding nonnegative excluded terms cannot lower it.
equation.interpretation: Every other subset's positive denominator gives EPS at least q; interacting effects are outside the derivation.
equation.transition: The report must then retain the same selected set for the separately supplied total-earnings increments.
